reasons: Compliant finding with no redline or comment, which is the expected output; the cited paragraphs support the conclusion.

Section 10.2(a) imposes a symmetric consent gate on the Depositor and the Servicer, and Sections 5.3 and 7.6 supply mirror-image merger/consolidation/business-successor/Affiliate carve-outs with notice, Officer's Certificate and opinions only — i.e., at least the fallback position (mutual assignment to successors with notice), so no redline is warranted.

No 'change of control' trigger appears in the cited text, and Section 7.1 (No Resignation) prevents the Servicer from exiting absent legal inability, so the walk-away scenarios (blanket bar on Customer assignment without M&A carve-out; Vendor termination/re-pricing on change of control) are absent.

Shortfalls from the pure preferred wording (no 'not unreasonably withheld' standard, no competitor bar, free Cellco delegation under Section 6.4 mitigated by continuing responsibility) are correctly noted in the rationale rather than flagged as deviations, consistent with the classification semantics.
Deterministic check (successor/affiliate carve-out present) is consistent with the compliant classification.
